title: Remove the unused maestro terminal command and its Settings box
seam: src-tauri/src/commands/cli.rs and the CLI section of src/components/settings/UpdatesSettingsPanel.tsx
story: Settings → Updates used to have a 'CLI Command' box that offered to install a `maestro` command for opening folders from a terminal. It never worked on Windows, and nobody used it on Mac or Linux. The box is gone, along with the command behind it. A copy already installed on a Mac still opens folders, because Maestro still accepts a folder when it starts.

checks.criterion: Settings → Updates shows no 'CLI Command' section on any platform
checks.steps: Start Maestro fresh. Open Settings. Pick the Updates section.
checks.expected: Version, Last checked, Auto-check, Install on launch and Advanced are shown; no 'CLI Command' box, no "Install 'maestro' command in PATH" button and no 'Not available on Windows.' line.
